units.source_text: 写得的确很幼稚，但笔致饱满，显然前途有望。

en.t: Her writing was indeed very childish, but the brushwork was full and vigorous, clearly showing promise for the future.

units.source_text: 很像已故的外祖母的笔迹。

en.t: It looked very much like the handwriting of her late maternal grandmother.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了，觉得让她临现世风的字帖，一定容易进步。

en.t: When Prince Genji saw it, he thought that if she copied model calligraphy in the current style, she would surely improve quickly.

units.source_text: 书画之外，源氏公子又特地为她制造玩偶住的许多屋子，和她一起玩耍。

en.t: Besides calligraphy and painting, Prince Genji also specially made many little houses for her dolls to live in and played with her.

units.source_text: 他觉得这是最好的消遣方法。

en.t: He felt that this was the best way to pass the time.
